'''Security Services''' was a business located at [[Orondia station]]<ref name="Friends" /> and [[Stobar Spaceport/Legends|Stobar Spaceport]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured a multi-[[Color/Legends|colored]] sign in dark gray, grayish-green and white, stating the business' name in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="Brothers" />
